summary: Beyond SSH, Ansible can use any connection plugin, such as local, chroot, lxc or jail, and ansible-pull lets hosts pull configuration from a Git repo on a schedule.
questions: Can Ansible manage containers without SSH?
What connection types does Ansible support besides SSH?

answer_card.title: Other connection methods
answer_card.answer_md: Ansible can use any connection plugin, including local, chroot, lxc and jail. `ansible-pull` inverts the model: hosts "phone home" on a schedule, check out a Git repo, and apply configuration from it.
